title: 厦门岛与鼓浪屿城市建筑数据提取

source.title: CMAB – The World’s First National-Scale Multi-Attribute Building Dataset
source.sourceGeometry: Polygonal rooftops extracted from satellite imagery. They approximate building ground footprints; roof parallax can remain, especially for tall buildings.
source.heightSource: CMAB Height field in metres, based on modelling and combined source data. This Xiamen file does not attribute individually surveyed heights. Missing values remain zero.

processing.sourceCRS: EPSG:3857 (explicit source .prj; WGS 84 / Web Mercator Auxiliary Sphere)
processing.projection: Inverse Web Mercator to WGS84, then x=(lon-118.125)*101220, z=(24.48-lat)*111100.
processing.registrationMethod: A single translation after reprojection, fixed from island-wide building-mask correlation against OSM. No rubber-sheet, scale or rotation adjustment.
processing.scope: Whole source polygons whose interior point lies within the buffered Xiamen or Gulangyu polygons in islands.json.
processing.topology: Make invalid polygons valid, simplify preserving topology, snap to half-metre coordinates, retain interior rings and polygon parts of at least 6 square metres. Remove coincident roofs with IoU >= 0.86.
processing.heightProcessing: Nearest decimetre, metres above local ground. Missing data retain source code 0.
processing.osmAttribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors. Used for the existing island boundary and the georegistration cross-check. https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright

format.role: Input to the offline city-layout merge
format.record: uint16 heightDecimetres, uint8 function, uint8 heightSource, uint16 ringCount
format.ring: uint16 vertexCount, then vertexCount pairs of signed int16 x,z at 0.5 metres. Exterior first, interior rings follow; rings omit the repeated closing vertex. Exterior is CCW in XZ.

alignment.method: One-to-one polygon pairs selected by IoU >= 0.48 in either frame, on bundled OSM building footprints. Both medians use exactly the same pairs. OSM serves as a horizontal cross-check, not as height ground truth.
